scope: Two independent loopback-only test-env functional launches. This is real host-shell and window evidence, not a native Library release, a Kindle render, or performance evidence for the current ARM executable.

inputs.aa_launcher_transform: aa_runner.case_files; the shim's /mnt/us/RUN install root is redirected to its isolated fixture root
inputs.desktop_elf: Retained 2026-11-16 CPU resize-cache study application (c49d711), BiliComics 0.1.25, ELF64 x86-64
inputs.native_services: Existing packaging lifecycle test double, private lock and firmware profile; no network interface except loopback
inputs.timebase: CLOCK_MONOTONIC in a single host namespace
inputs.scene: Fresh synthetic design-demo data with the saved Shelf preference; no route override, clicks, private account, or artwork requirement

evidence_boundary: The real mark wrapper execs the retained shell or the fixture app adapter without a fork. Only that adapter substitutes a desktop exec for the native main application; the PID is followed across it into the actual ELF. The marked launcher still starts and waits for its real worker. The per-model host observations are single qualification cases, not comparative timings.
